# Issue #23: environment overrides are ignored

`load_config(defaults, env)` should let any key in `env` prefixed with `APP_`
override the matching lowercase key in `defaults`, with values coerced to the
type of the default (int, float, bool, str). Currently overrides are ignored.

1| def load_config(defaults: dict, env: dict) -> dict:
   2|     """Return a copy of `defaults` where any env var APP_<KEY> overrides the
   3|     value for key <key> (lowercased), coerced to the type of the default."""
   4|     cfg = dict(defaults)
   5| 
   6|     for name, value in env.items():
   7|         if not name.startswith("APP_"):
   8|             continue
   9| 
  10|         key = name[4:].lower()
  11|         if key not in defaults:
  12|             continue
  13| 
  14|         default = defaults[key]
  15|         if isinstance(default, bool):
  16|             normalized = value.strip().lower()
  17|             if normalized in {"true", "1", "yes", "on"}:
  18|                 cfg[key] = True
  19|             elif normalized in {"false", "0", "no", "off"}:
  20|                 cfg[key] = False
  21|             else:
  22|                 raise ValueError(f"invalid boolean value for {name}: {value!r}")
  23|         elif isinstance(default, int):
  24|             cfg[key] = int(value)
  25|         elif isinstance(default, float):
  26|             cfg[key] = float(value)
  27|         elif isinstance(default, str):
  28|             cfg[key] = value
  29| 
  30|     return cfg

arguments.summary: Implemented environment overrides in `cfg/loader.py`: APP_-prefixed names now map case-insensitively to existing lowercase default keys, with int, float, string, and explicit boolean coercion while preserving unrelated or unknown settings.
